messages:
Priya (AE): Hey team — kickoff for FinTrust POC. Customer wants a private/on-prem style POC (VPC) with 32k context, tool-calls for doc retrieval + payments API, embeddings for semantic search, and a reranker for answer quality. They want success criteria, pricing for a 6-week run, and the security questionnaire answered. Can SE/Eng confirm capability fit and rough cadence?

Evan (SE): Quick take: 32k context is fine on our larger variants (we should use a 32k-optimized model). Tool-calling is supported (structured function calls + sandboxed network egress). Need to confirm expected concurrency (RPS) and P95 latency SLO to size Dedicated vs Private. Also: will they accept quantized weights for cost or insist on FP16?

Jordan (Eng): Confirmed — we support function/tool calling and routing to a private deployment. We can pin model version and run on Dedicated capacity in their VPC. For on-prem we need customer infra checklist but we have an OOB package. Example route policy we can push:
```
routing:
  prefer: private_vpc
  fallback: dedicated_region
  guardrail: max_latency_ms: 800
```
This buys predictable latency.

Samir (Security): Heads-up — we need answers on data residency, KMS/HSM integration, retention windows, whether raw logs can leave the VPC, and their SSP/SOC2 reqs. Also ask if they require model provenance (weights from specific repos) and a supply-chain attestation. I'll send the security spreadsheet link.

Priya (AE): Pricing Q from customer: are we able to provide a short-term discounted commit for a <6wk> POC or should we offer usage credits? They asked about a dedicated node price and an estimate for token spend.

Evan (SE): For a 6-week POC we usually offer: 2-week free dedicated trial + usage credits for the remainder OR a short monthly reserved for the POC at 30% off list. Estimate math (very rough): 10 power users, avg 50k tokens/user/day -> 10 * 50k * 42 days = 21M tokens. At $0.02/1k tokens that's ~$420. Dedicated node flat is separate; expect ~$Xk/mo depending on GPU class — I'll confirm.

Jordan (Eng): Success criteria proposal:
- Latency: P95 < 600ms for interactive chat on typical 2k-response flows
- Availability: 99% uptime during business hours (mon-fri 9–6)
- Relevance: semantic search retrieval Precision@5 >= 0.8 on their eval set
- Reranker lift: +15% NDCG over raw embeddings on the 1k canonical queries set
- Security: no external logs allowed off their VPC; KMS key managed by customer
We should run a 1k prompt eval before/after reranker to measure lift.

Priya (AE): Great. Customer also asked about embedding dimensionality and storage. They plan to store vectors in their Milvus cluster in the VPC. Are there compatibility quirks?

Evan (SE): Embedding dims are model-dependent — recommend 1536 or 3072 depending on model. We can produce vectors in standard float32; if they want quantized vectors for storage we can provide guidance. We also support a reranking pipeline that ingests candidate ids and scores them with the generation model.

Samir (Security): I uploaded the SF Security sheet (link shared in DM). Action required: fill sections A (data scope), B (network controls), and D (key mgmt). For on-prem we need a signed connectivity diagram.

Priya (AE): Action items / owners: Evan -> finalize token cost estimate + dedicated pricing (EOD Thu). Jordan -> confirm deployment checklist for on-prem (incl infra reqs) and provide example routing policy (Tue). Samir -> security spreadsheet drop and required docs (Thu). I'll coordinate with FinTrust point-of-contact and schedule weekly check-ins.

Evan (SE): I'll also draft an eval harness: 1k query set, tooling to measure P95 latency, and a simple load script. Will push to the repo and share link.

Jordan (Eng): If they're strict about model provenance, we may need a short lockfile of the model bundle we deploy — I can produce that.

Priya (AE): OK team — I'll send calendar invites. Next sync Friday 11am PT with FinTrust + internal owners. @ops-bot please create a POC ticket in the tracker with these ACs. :thumbsup:
